package rulefixtures

import (
	"maps"
)

// scenario for repeated_map_clone_in_loop: maps.Clone or equivalent map-copy calls observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func scenario361Positive(source map[string]int, keys []string) []map[string]int {
	var results []map[string]int
	for _, k := range keys {
		clone := maps.Clone(source)
		clone[k] = clone[k] + 1
		results = append(results, clone)
	}
	return results
}
